goal: Report internal read and corruption errors instead of falsely claiming a confirmed transaction is missing
Help RPC clients and node operators distinguish missing transactions from disk or index failures
reviewability: Needs rebase against master, but the logic is ready to review now because the rebase is mechanical
agreement: Strong support for separating missing transaction results from internal I/O errors
Concept approval for distinguishing missing transactions from read failures (yuvicc, musaHaruna)
Objection that pruned blocks reported an I/O error was resolved with an availability check (yuvicc)

categories.name: indexes
why: P3 because index read failures and corruption are no longer silently treated as missing transactions
Node operators get warned of potential index or disk corruption instead of receiving false negatives

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because callers receive accurate error diagnostics rather than misleading transaction-not-found errors
Prevents downstream client applications from misinterpreting disk faults as non-existent transactions
